# README.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/README.md

<p align="center">
  <img alt="svelte-ux logo" height="100px" src="./static/logos/logo.jpg" />  
</p>
<h1 align="center">Svelte UX</h1>

![](https://img.shields.io/github/license/techniq/svelte-ux?style=flat)

![](https://img.shields.io/github/license/svelte-ux?style=flat)

The projects aims to simplify building highly interactive and visual applications. It provides over 200 components, actions, stores, and utils, with many more planned.

The components are built using Tailwind with extensibility and customization in mind through the use of theming, variants, granular class overrides, and slots. A rich design token system is also currently in the works.

See also the companion library [LayerChart](https://layerchart.com) for a large collection of composable chart components to build a wide range of visualizations.

## Contributing

### Install dependencies

```
pnpm i
```

### Run dev server for `svelte-ux` package

```
cd packages/svelte-ux
pnpm dev
```

### Run test for `svelte-ux` package

```
cd packages/svelte-ux
pnpm test:unit
```

### Run tests for all packages

```
pnpm -r test:unit
```

### Run a script from the root

```
pnpm -F svelte-ux dev
```

### Add changeset to include change in changelog and determine next version

```
pnpm changeset
```

# +page.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/packages/svelte-ux/src/routes/docs/components/AppLayout/+page.md

import Blockquote from '$docs/Blockquote.svelte';

<h1>Example</h1>

<h2>Basic (full height nav)</h2>

```svelte
<AppLayout>
  <svelte:fragment slot="nav">
    <!-- Nav menu -->
  </svelte:fragment>

  <AppBar title="Example">
    <div slot="actions">
      <!-- App actions -->
    </div>
  </AppBar>

  <main>
    <slot />
  </main>
</AppLayout>
```

<h2>Full width layout</h2>

```svelte
<AppLayout areas="'header header' 'aside main'">
  <svelte:fragment slot="nav">
    <!-- Nav menu -->
  </svelte:fragment>

  <AppBar title="Example">
    <div slot="actions">
      <!-- App actions -->
    </div>
  </AppBar>

  <main>
    <slot />
  </main>
</AppLayout>
```

# +page.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/packages/svelte-ux/src/routes/docs/components/Paginate/+page.md

import { ListItem, Pagination, Paginate } from 'svelte-ux';

	import Preview from '$lib/components/Preview.svelte';

	const data = Array(100).fill(null).map((x, i) => ({ name: `Item: ${i + 1}`}))

<h1>Usage</h1>

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Paginate, Pagination } from 'svelte-ux';
</script>

<Paginate {data} let:pageData let:pagination>
  {#each pageData as d}
    <!-- render item -->
  {/each}
  <Pagination {pagination} />
</Paginate>
```

<h2>Default</h2>

<Preview>
	<Paginate {data} let:pageData let:pagination>
		{#each pageData as d}
			<ListItem title={d.name} />
		{/each}
		{#if pageData.length > 0}
			<Pagination {pagination} />
		{/if}
	</Paginate>
</Preview>

<h2>Per page</h2>

<Preview>
	<Paginate {data} perPage={5} let:pageData let:pagination>
		{#each pageData as d}
			<ListItem title={d.name} />
		{/each}
		{#if pageData.length > 0}
			<Pagination {pagination} />
		{/if}
	</Paginate>
</Preview>

# +page.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/packages/svelte-ux/src/routes/docs/components/Pagination/+page.md

import { Button, Pagination } from 'svelte-ux';
	import { paginationStore } from '@layerstack/svelte-stores';

	import Preview from '$lib/components/Preview.svelte';

	const pagination = paginationStore();
	pagination.setTotal(100);

<h1>Usage</h1>

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Pagination, paginationStore } from 'svelte-ux';

  const pagination = paginationStore();
  pagination.setTotal(100);
</script>

<Pagination {pagination} />
```

<h2>Default</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} />
</Preview>

<h2>First/Last page</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['firstPage', 'prevPage', 'pagination', 'nextPage', 'lastPage']} />
</Preview>

<h2>Center pagination</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['firstPage', 'prevPage', 'pagination', 'nextPage', 'lastPage']} classes={{ pagination: 'flex-1 text-center' }} />
</Preview>

<h2>format</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['firstPage', 'prevPage', 'pagination', 'nextPage', 'lastPage']} classes={{ pagination: 'flex-1 text-center' }} format={pagination => 'Page ' + pagination.page + ' of ' + pagination.totalPages} />
</Preview>

<h2>Pagination slot</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['firstPage', 'prevPage', 'pagination', 'nextPage', 'lastPage']}>
		<div slot="pagination" class="text-sm flex-1 text-center" let:pagination>
			Page {pagination.page} of {pagination.totalPages}
		</div>
	</Pagination>
</Preview>

<h2>Table pagination</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['perPage', 'pagination', 'prevPage', 'nextPage']} classes={{ perPage: 'flex-1 text-right', pagination: 'px-8' }} />
</Preview>

<h2>Table pagination with actions slot</h2>

<Preview>
	<Pagination {pagination} show={['actions', 'perPage', 'pagination', 'prevPage', 'nextPage']} classes={{ perPage: 'flex-1 text-right', pagination: 'px-8' }}>
		<div slot="actions">
			<Button variant="fill" color="primary">Click me</Button>
		</div>
	</Pagination>
</Preview>

# +page.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/packages/svelte-ux/src/routes/docs/components/State/+page.md

```svelte
<State initial={selected} let:value let:set>
	{#each items as item}
		<Button on:click={set(item)}>
			{item.name}
		</Button>
	{/each}
</Toggle>
```

# +page.md

Source: https://github.com/techniq/svelte-ux/blob/main/packages/svelte-ux/src/routes/docs/components/Toggle/+page.md

```svelte
<Toggle let:on={open} let:toggle let:toggleOff>
  <Button on:click={toggle}>Show dialog</Button>

  <Dialog {open} on:close={toggleOff}>
    <!-- render contents -->
  </Dialog>
</Toggle>
```
